manifest.clothModel: skeletal reference with regional implicit secondary cloth
manifest.jumpFraming: uses vertical envelope of the actual retained native jump clip
manifest.linearSolve: fused three-axis graph access; stop only at an unchanged full sweep; original scalar 8 sweeps retained for QA
manifest.facePassRouting: same-frame full beauty depth, two native-skin-only auxiliary passes
manifest.demonstration: live walk/run/jump driven by committed simulation time
manifest.samplingPolicy: screen error hysteresis; stationary camera motion never repeatedly coarsens
manifest.workerScheduling: next fixed-step deadline; monotonic actual wall target; no discarded time
manifest.shadowPolicy: primary key shadows; colored rim and neutral fill retained
manifest.rejectedLiveSnapshotInterpolation: extra main-thread cost; not used in the released runtime
manifest.denimCrimpSampling: continuous projected error; eight initial segments per 48 mm; even cross sections at least six sides
manifest.denimDraftFilter: separable pixel box coverage of the original discrete 4x4 3:1 draft; not continuous stripes
manifest.denimBleachPigmentChannels: blue warp, pale neutral weft, material-space dye loss
manifest.userFeedbackAddressed: light denim was too flat; retain yarn normals, visual relief and cotton sheen
manifest.denimBleachFilteredRelief: screen-pixel-integrated first-band 3:1 float normals plus original macro yarn geometry
manifest.denimFarFilter: continuous screen-footprint Nyquist fade of draft colour and relief; unresolved strand highlights converge to cloth normal; dye-loss and roughness noise filtered separately
manifest.seamModel: common material-edge refinement and explicit welded equalities for every sewn boundary site
manifest.lowerBodyContact: actual native lower-body triangles with seam-region vertex and centroid projection
manifest.crotchProjection: one final residual-contact cleanup; original panel front/back identity and shared native pelvis frame; native-body ray clearance search only in rise region
manifest.contactQueryReuse: exactly unchanged native-body positions and exactly unchanged cloth sample coordinates with satisfied clearance
manifest.fineContactDistribution: coherent material-triangle translation; lumped area masses and coarse partition rebuilt from the current material mesh

riseMaterialRefinement.method: barycentric split inside existing rise-adjacent material triangles with an edge longer than 20 mm
